entities.summary: Jan Huitema is a Dutch politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2014 to 2024. He is a member of the People's Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD), part of Renew Europe in the European Parliament, until 2019 the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe.
